title: silene maritima subsp. alpina
intro: Silene maritima subsp. alpina, commonly known as a type of catchfly, is a flowering plant species within the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Silene maritima subsp. alpina include antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit potential in modulating the immune system and protecting against oxidative stress.
